notes.title: Zombie Watch Part II - Update 0.6
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43757180/be0e7b525640fee57e35e76cf19daabb65a9a307.png[/img]

Hello,

this update brings an exciting addition to Zombie Watch Part II as well as fixes several game-breaking bugs that were affecting the gameplay experience for some players. 

We added a new feature where players can now recruit and manage survivors to work for them, providing them with water, food, and medicine, or else they will perish. These survivors are your companions when exploring the game's vast open world and they will defend you and fight the zombies by your side. This feature adds a whole new layer of strategy and immersion to the game. They will be more useful as the development of the game goes further.

Additionally, the update has introduced new decorative items that players can use to customize their bases and make them more visually appealing.

Last but not least, we have continued to work on bugfixes to ensure that the game is running smoothly and without issue. Overall, these updates have made Zombie Watch an even more engaging and immersive survival game. 

Updates:
- survivors - hire more survivors if they die - food, water, medicine - they fight for you
 they will do more things when new functionalities are developed
- New decorative buildable's chair, table, fence 
- Added sensitivity slider
- Remapped change next/previous building
- Bugfixes
